Fetch template tarball from GitHub instead of local copy
Run git init in the new project

brand.description: Brand / business name shown on the site
Short brand label for compact UI

database.description: Write .env only; do not run prisma db push
Force prisma db push after .env setup

list.title: List templates
list.description: Shows all template ids, names, versions, and short descriptions from templates.json.

info.title: Template details
info.description: Print stack, features, setup time, and quick-start commands for one template.

arguments.name: template-id
arguments.description: CLI id from list (e.g. hotel, real-estate)

generate.title: Generate a project
generate.description: Copies the template into the current directory (flat, no nested folder). Creates .tempjs.json with version stamp and file hashes.

examples.label: Non-interactive with brand + DB
examples.command: tempjs hotel --config --yes --name "Mi Plaza" --base-url https://miplaza.com --db-host localhost --db-name mi_plaza_db

examples.label: Quick copy only
examples.command: mkdir client-site && cd client-site && tempjs hotel --yes

theme.title: Change theme
theme.description: Updates theme colors in an existing generated project (requires .tempjsrc or prior setup).

font.title: Change font
font.description: Updates typography preset in a generated project.

brand.title: Update brand & contact
brand.description: Rewrites constants/site.ts with brand name, URL, phone, and email.

init-db.title: Configure database
init-db.description: Creates or updates .env with DATABASE_URL and admin credentials. Optionally runs prisma db push.

examples.label: Local MariaDB via Docker defaults
examples.command: tempjs init-db --yes --db-host localhost --db-user root --db-password password --db-name app_db

doctor.title: Project health check
doctor.description: Answers "Can I run this project?" — checks Node, node_modules, .env, database, .tempjs.json version, optional /api/health.

add-module.title: Add optional core modules
add-module.description: Installs core modules from packages/core/modules.json into an existing client project. Merges Prisma, enables SITE.features flags, records .tempjs-modules.json. Gallery/reviews update app/admin/registry.ts on the unified /admin dashboard. Does not overwrite app/page.tsx.

add-module-list.title: List core modules
add-module-list.description: Shows all optional core module ids and descriptions from packages/core/modules.json.

update-check.title: Check template updates
update-check.description: Compares your project to the latest template: new files, safe updates, and conflicts. Read-only.

update-merge.title: Apply safe updates
update-merge.description: Merges non-conflicting files from the latest template. Protects .env, constants/site.ts, and brand files.

sync-templates.title: Propagate core (optional)
sync-templates.description: Copies packages/core shared files into existing template folders. Use only after fixing shared auth/leads/storage in core — not part of normal template development.

template-diff-core.title: Diff template vs core
template-diff-core.description: Reports which core-owned paths match, differ, or are missing — plus template-only files sync would not touch. Exit code 1 if propagate would change files.

template-validate.title: Validate template
template-validate.description: Runs prisma validate, TypeScript (tsc --noEmit), and ESLint in the template folder. Installs deps if node_modules is missing.

dev-hotel.title: Dev server (hotel)
dev-hotel.description: Runs pnpm dev in templates/hotel-website-template/. Does not run sync.

version-check.title: Check unreleased changes
version-check.description: Compares git changes since last version bump for CLI or templates. Monorepo root only.

version-inc.title: Bump version
version-inc.description: Increments CLI package.json or templates.json. Template bumps track changes in templates/<directory>/.

new-template.title: Create new template
new-template.description: Copies packages/core + scaffold into templates/<directory>/, merges Prisma, updates templates.json, adds pnpm dev:<id>. Use --modules to copy optional pieces from packages/core/modules/. Use --with-docs to add docsite registry stubs.

arguments.name: --modules
arguments.description: Comma-separated core module ids (see Optional modules page)

template-add-module.title: Add core module to template
template-add-module.description: Copies optional module files from packages/core/modules/ into an existing template in the monorepo, enables SITE.features flags, merges Prisma, updates .tempjs-modules.json.

template-assemble.title: Assemble template vertical modules
template-assemble.description: Copies paths from templates/<dir>/modules/<id>/ into the template root per template-modules.json. With no module ids, assembles all registered vertical modules.

template-extract-modules.title: Extract into modules/
template-extract-modules.description: Copies template root paths into templates/<dir>/modules/<id>/ for maintainer source-of-truth workflow. Bootstrap or refresh module folders from assembled template files.
